method.facilities: Current Angus Council public-toilet and off-street-parking directories were checked by exact place name; OSM candidates remain discovery evidence only.
method.linkCheck: Every currently published visitorWebsiteUrl in the 182 Angus projects received a current HTTP request; blocked responses remain review items rather than automatic deletions.
